operationalIncident.summary: The first Catalog launcher inherited CATALOG_EVENTS_ENABLED=true while RabbitMQ was unavailable, so the outbox relay incremented attempts before the process was stopped.
operationalIncident.mitigation: Stopped the unsafe Catalog process, reran verification on port 18092 with CATALOG_EVENTS_ENABLED=false, and made no repair or deletion to outbox rows.

readOnlyObservationAfterward.attribution: No pre-incident baseline exists, so these totals must not be attributed entirely to this run.

nextStep: HAI-11.5 requires separate approval because controlled backfill writes ai_search.
